method: Synthesis over Printing Press YC CLI source pack plus qualified Reddit evidence pack. Company records are inputs, not slide copy.
bluf: Reddit validates category pain in a narrow subset of YC agentic AI wedges; it does not validate the full company list.
core_thesis: The strongest near-term agentic AI opportunities are not generic AI-agent companies. They are workflow wedges where operators coordinate fragmented systems, lose value when handoffs fail, and can point to concrete manual work or rework in public practitioner discussion.
decision: Prioritize property management and construction review for deeper diligence; re-test clinic and hotel operations with narrower operator-source collection; keep finance, insurance, mortgage, therapy, and lending claims out of the validated narrative until primary or operator evidence improves.
